blocks.text: Have you ever wondered how Nigeria decides on its economic priorities and allocates resources to achieve national goals?

blocks.markdown: Economic planning involves setting goals for a country's economy and outlining how to achieve them. This process is crucial for guiding economic growth and development, particularly in a country like Nigeria.

blocks.title: Definition of Economic Planning
blocks.text: Economic planning is the process by which key economic decisions are made or influenced by central governments to achieve specific goals.

blocks.markdown: Economic planning in Nigeria aims to improve living standards, reduce poverty, and foster sustainable growth. Objectives include increasing employment, stabilizing prices, and ensuring equitable distribution of resources.

blocks.title: Example of a Development Plan

steps.text: Vision 2020 aimed to position Nigeria among the top 20 economies by the year 2020.
It focused on improving infrastructure, education, and healthcare.

blocks.answer: The plan set specific targets for economic growth and social development.

blocks.markdown: Development plans are long-term strategies, typically spanning 5 to 10 years. In contrast, rolling plans are short-term and reviewed annually to adjust for changing circumstances.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Remember to differentiate between development plans and rolling plans by their duration and flexibility.

blocks.markdown: Several factors have led to the failure of some Nigerian economic plans, such as political instability, corruption, and inadequate data for planning.

points: Economic planning is essential for setting and achieving national economic goals.
Development plans are long-term, while rolling plans are short-term and adaptable.
Challenges like political instability and corruption can hinder the success of economic plans.
